run_InferencePipeline: run the InferencePipeline on an input image to generate a 3D mesh and GLB output
build_InferencePipeline: build an InferencePipeline instance with config paths and checkpoint paths for all sparse structure and SLAT models
run_sample_sparse_structure: run sample_sparse_structure to generate 3D sparse structure coordinates from a preprocessed image dictionary
run_sample_slat: run sample_slat to generate structured latent features conditioned on image input and sparse structure coordinates
run_decode_slat: run decode_slat to convert a sparse latent tensor into mesh and gaussian splat formats
